native_mechanisms: Servant's silence-swats: the marks' order is fixed and absorbed unspoken onto the flat stone before any folding (ordered, chain-free intake plus padding).

Each heap races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist, downhill fold, doubling-back that eats its own trail — and is re-searched in squares turned ninety degrees, so no heap keeps the shape it entered with and one changed mark smears across every square.
The owl seals the final folded shape to one fixed small size, one-way, while every intermediate heap is burned so the token cannot be walked back to its marks.
core_technique: Wide ARX permutation sponge: input blocks XOR-absorbed into a 4x4 (twin 4x4 under AVX2) 64-bit state, mixed by BLAKE2b-G add/xor/rotate rounds applied to columns then lane-rotated (diagonal) orientations, with extra finalization rounds and a Murmur3 fmix64 fold to 64 bits.
